title: Local realization of equivariant geometric-point maps
statement: Let K be a field [def-pc-field-extension], Ksep a separable closure, and X,Y etale K-schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Equip their K-geometric points with the action of [lem-exc-etale-field-geometric-action-continuous]. For every equivariant map φ between these actions and every x in X, there is an open neighbourhood U of x and a K-morphism U→Y whose effect on every geometric point of U is φ.

source.place: Tag 03QR, full-faithfulness proof, using Morphisms Tag 02GL

proof.text: Construct the singleton chart directly over K in the proved private helper singleton_chart, without transporting a scheme-theoretic fibre. Mathlib Scheme.Hom.isDiscrete_preimage_singleton, with the singleton of Spec K equal to the entire base, makes X discrete. The source-library etale_residueFieldMap and the isomorphism from the base residue-field spectrum show that the composite Spec κ(x) → X → Spec K is étale. Algebra.FormallyUnramified.finite_of_free and Algebra.FormallyEtale.iff_isSeparable make κ(x)/K finite separable. Reducedness follows from [etale-proposition-etale-reduced]. Lift the residue-field point to the singleton open U by IsOpenImmersion.lift. Its lift is a surjective preimmersion, hence a closed immersion because U is discrete; reducedness of U makes it an isomorphism. The inverse gives the chart over Spec K.

Let L = κ(x) and send each K-embedding σ:L→Ksep to its geometric point on X through the singleton chart. Applying the given equivariant map gives geometric points b(σ) of Y. Nonemptiness and transitivity from [lem-exc-etale-field-galois-classification], together with equivariance and the one-point spectrum of Ksep, show that every b(σ) has the same underlying point y. Apply singleton_chart to Y at y, obtaining a finite separable extension M=κ(y) and a singleton chart V. Lift each b(σ) through V and compose with its chart to obtain a map Spec Ksep→Spec M. Spec.homEquiv and the equality over Spec K turn it into τ(σ):M→ₐ[K]Ksep. Cancel the monomorphism Spec M→Y to prove equivariance of τ. The surjectivity clause of the same Galois classification then produces f₀:M→ₐ[K]L with σ.comp f₀=τ(σ) for every σ.

Set f equal to the source chart followed by Spec(f₀) and the inverse target chart and open immersion. The commutes identity of f₀ and Spec.map_comp prove f≫Y.hom=U.ι≫X.hom. For an arbitrary geometric point p of U over K, Spec.homEquiv of p followed by the chart gives a K-embedding σ of L. Its geometric point on X equals p followed by U.ι. The identity σ.comp f₀=τ(σ), transported through Spec, and the defining factorization of τ prove the required equality p≫f=φ(p≫U.ι). Empty sources have no x, and the construction of b(σ₀) supplies the target point whenever x exists.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03QR with Morphisms Tag 02GL(1); direct singleton residue-field charts via proved source-library and Mathlib tools, followed by the finite-separable Galois Hom bijection (W2 Lean realization)

lean.statement: theorem etaleFieldPointMap_local (K Ksep : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ksep] [Algebra K Ksep] [IsSepClosure K Ksep] (X Y : Scheme.Etale (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) (φ : etaleFieldGeometricAction K Ksep X ⟶ etaleFieldGeometricAction K Ksep Y) (x : X.left) : ∃ U : X.left.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ ∃ f : U.toScheme ⟶ Y.left, f ≫ Y.hom = U.ι ≫ X.hom ∧ ∀ (p : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ksep) ⟶ U.toScheme) (hp : p ≫ (U.ι ≫ X.hom) = (etaleFieldBasePoint K Ksep).hom), p ≫ f = (φ.hom (Over.homMk (p ≫ U.ι) (by simpa using hp))).left
